name: gen_support_case_summary
task: A support agent dictates a concise customer support case summary document with a heading and a short list of actions.

turns.say: Heading case summary for nora blanchard, ticket id seven five four two one.
Um okay so she called on march third, twenty twenty five, about a double charge on her pro plan.
The amount was ninety nine dollars, no wait, make that one hundred nine dollars, plus tax.
She said the card ending in four two one one was billed twice after a plan upgrade.
New paragraph. I verified invoices and found two successful captures in stripe for the same order.
Make that a list. One, apologized and confirmed identity. Two, refunded the duplicate charge. Three, emailed receipt.
Change stripe to Stripe in the writeup, and note refund id r f n d nine eight six.
Close with next steps: monitor for three to five business days and reply if it doesn't post.

judge.criteria: Output should be a clean case summary with a visible heading, convert spoken numbers to figures (ticket id, amount, card last4, refund id), remove disfluencies/commands, include a 3+ item numbered list of actions, and capitalize Stripe.
